title: Topic 12 旅行 Travel
japanese_text: たくさんの<ruby>人<rt>ひと</rt></ruby>を乗せた<u>モノレール</u>の<u>ブレーキ</u>が<ruby>故障<rt>こしょう</rt></ruby>し、<ruby>駅<rt>えき</rt></ruby>の<ruby>壁<rt>かべ</rt></ruby>にぶつかる<ruby>事故<rt>じこ</rt></ruby>が<ruby>起<rt>お</rt></ruby>きた。<ruby>駅<rt>えき</rt></ruby>では<u>サイレン</u>が<ruby>鳴<rt>な</rt></ruby>り<ruby>響<rt>ひび</rt></ruby>き、たくさんの<ruby>人<rt>ひと</rt></ruby>が<u>非常口</u>に<ruby>集<rt>あつ</rt></ruby>まり、けが<ruby>人<rt>にん</rt></ruby>が<ruby>出<rt>で</rt></ruby>た。
english_translation: There was an accident involving the brakes failing on a monorail full of passengers where the monorail hit the wall of a station. The station sirens wailed and many people were gathered around the emergency exits. Some were injured.
